name: Richard Fong
bio: Came to SEO from finance and runs every campaign like a portfolio: steady gains that stack on each other. Has compounded Bliss Drive into a 7-figure agency. As host of DGS, he runs the Friday table and keeps the accountability round honest.

name: Chris Koszo
bio: A one-man shop with big-firm aim. Lands #1 rankings for lawyers in some of the toughest legal markets, consults on enterprise and international SEO for brands like Cathay Pacific, Purina and Microsoft, and once outranked NASA.gov just for fun.

name: Andrew Ansley
bio: Philosophy grad turned entity-SEO authority who built and sold an agency. Now building Thorbit, an SEO agent that runs a site on its own: building pages, writing schema, fixing errors and submitting to Google and Bing around the clock.

name: Brian Winum
bio: Building brands in search since 1998 and a four-time SEO Spring Training speaker. His WP Content Ledger signs every post and timestamps it on the Bitcoin blockchain, so authorship can be proven.

name: Chris Castillo
bio: Runs his agency with a team of AI agents, each with a name: Neo handles support, Cypher writes the code and Vector runs SEO. Strategy built around ROI and conversion.

name: Chas Henry
bio: Local SEO for small and mid-size businesses across the Tupelo area. Ranked a top web design firm in Mississippi by DesignRush.

name: Chris Labbate
bio: Started doing SEO in 1998, the same year Google was founded. Built master-metrics.com in-house, migrates 4,000-page stores without losing rankings, and still takes pages to #1 with entities and advanced schema.

name: Cory Hubbell
bio: Builds his own AI instead of renting it. His agents write schema, ship top-shelf client sites in a day or two, and hunt down server attacks. If a tool isn’t open, he builds a better one.

name: Mike Merlino
bio: Straight talk and big energy. A CMO by trade and co-founder of Pocket Marketer who measures SEO in dollars per call. Believes he who has the compute wins, so he runs his own hardware and local AI models.

name: Brian Kato
bio: Former BMI-affiliated rock frontman turned brand-SEO strategist, and still touring: now it’s the 2026 SEO Tour, teaching cohorts from the U.S. to London. Works where cybersecurity meets marketing.

name: Brian Hong
bio: In SEO since 2000. Now building AI revenue engines, including Flowbots and an intent-data product that turns cold outreach into booked appointments. Prefers to get paid on outcomes.

name: Simon Cornelius
bio: A self-described introvert who loves networking, and an engineer at heart: if he has to do something twice, he writes a tool for it. Built his own accounting app in an afternoon rather than pay for one, and teaches an Entities & Schema course.
